mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_task (order_id, material_type, name, spec, quantity, usage_desc, reference_note, deadline, status, assignee_id) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{materialType}, #{name}, #{spec}, #{quantity}, #{usageDesc}, #{referenceNote}, #{deadline}, #{status}, #{assigneeId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, material_type, name, spec, quantity, usage_desc, reference_note, deadline, status, assignee_id, assigned_at, created_at, updated_at FROM material_task WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT t.id AS `id`, t.order_id AS `orderId`, t.material_type AS `materialType`, t.name AS `name`, t.spec AS `spec`, t.quantity AS `quantity`, t.usage_desc AS `usageDesc`, t.reference_note AS `referenceNote`, t.deadline AS `deadline`, t.status AS `status`, t.assignee_id AS `assigneeId`, t.assigned_at AS `assignedAt`, t.created_at AS `createdAt`, u.real_name AS `assigneeName`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM design_version v WHERE v.task_id = t.id) AS `versionCount` FROM material_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY t.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_task WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status != 'CONFIRMED'

SELECT t.id AS `id`, t.order_id AS `orderId`, o.order_no AS `orderNo`, o.title AS `orderTitle`, o.status AS `orderStatus`, o.deadline AS `orderDeadline`, c.name AS `customerName`, t.material_type AS `materialType`, t.name AS `name`, t.spec AS `spec`, t.quantity AS `quantity`, t.deadline AS `deadline`, t.status AS `status`, t.assignee_id AS `assigneeId`, u.real_name AS `assigneeName`, t.assigned_at AS `assignedAt`, t.created_at AS `createdAt`, t.updated_at AS `updatedAt`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM design_version v WHERE v.task_id = t.id) AS `versionCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM revision_feedback f WHERE f.task_id = t.id) AS `feedbackCount`
ORDER BY FIELD(t.status, 'REVISION', 'PENDING_CONFIRM', 'DESIGNING', 'PENDING', 'CONFIRMED'), t.deadline IS NULL, t.deadline, t.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT MAX(deadline) FROM material_task WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_task WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND assignee_id = #{assigneeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_task SET status = #{to} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
UPDATE material_task SET assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, assigned_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE material_task SET deadline = #{deadline} WHERE id = #{id}
